verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֥ר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: The LORD spoke again to Moses . . . and Aaron telling them
verses.literalPt: E FALOU o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo-lhes:

verses.original: דַּבְּר֛וּ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֹ֤את הַֽחַיָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאכְל֔וּ מִכָּל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bə·rū ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr zōṯ ha·ḥay·yāh ’ă·šer tō·ḵə·lū mik·kāl hab·bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Say to the Israelites . . . - Of all the beasts of the earth these ones you may eat
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Estes são os animais, que comereis dentre todos os animais que há sobre a terra;

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל׀ מַפְרֶ֣סֶת פַּרְסָ֗ה וְשֹׁסַ֤עַת שֶׁ֙סַע֙ פְּרָסֹ֔ת מַעֲלַ֥ת גֵּרָ֖ה בַּבְּהֵמָ֑ה אֹתָ֖הּ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōl map̄·re·seṯ par·sāh wə·šō·sa·‘aṯ še·sa‘ pə·rā·sōṯ ma·‘ă·laṯ gê·rāh bab·bə·hê·māh ’ō·ṯāh tō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: You may eat any animal that has a split . . . hoof completely divided and that chews the cud
verses.literalPt: Dentre os animais, todo o que tem unhas fendidas, e a fenda das unhas se divide em duas, e rumina, deles comereis.

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ אֶת־ זֶה֙ לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֔וּ מִֽמַּעֲלֵי֙ הַגֵּרָ֔ה וּמִמַּפְרִיסֵ֖י הַפַּרְסָ֑ה אֶֽת־ הַ֠גָּמָל כִּֽי־ מַעֲלֵ֨ה גֵרָ֜ה ה֗וּא וּפַרְסָה֙ אֵינֶ֣נּוּ מַפְרִ֔יס טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’eṯ- zeh lō ṯō·ḵə·lū mim·ma·‘ă·lê hag·gê·rāh ū·mim·map̄·rî·sê hap·par·sāh ’eṯ- hag·gā·māl kî- ma·‘ă·lêh ḡê·rāh hū ū·p̄ar·sāh ’ê·nen·nū map̄·rîs ṭā·mê hū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: But of those that only chew the cud or only have a divided hoof you are not to eat the following The camel though it chews the cud does not have a divided hoof it is unclean for you
verses.literalPt: Destes, porém, não comereis; dos que ruminam ou dos que têm unhas fendidas; o camelo, que rumina, mas não tem unhas fendidas; esse vos será imundo;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁפָ֗ן כִּֽי־ מַעֲלֵ֤ה גֵרָה֙ ה֔וּא וּפַרְסָ֖ה לֹ֣א יַפְרִ֑יס טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- haš·šā·p̄ān kî- ma·‘ă·lêh ḡê·rāh hū ū·p̄ar·sāh lō yap̄·rîs ṭā·mê hū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: The rock badger though it chews the cud does not have a divided hoof it is unclean for you
verses.literalPt: E o coelho, porque rumina, mas não tem as unhas fendidas; esse vos será imundo;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הָאַרְנֶ֗בֶת כִּֽי־ מַעֲלַ֤ת גֵּרָה֙ הִ֔וא וּפַרְסָ֖ה לֹ֣א הִפְרִ֑יסָה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִ֖וא לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·’ar·ne·ḇeṯ kî- ma·‘ă·laṯ gê·rāh hî ū·p̄ar·sāh lō hip̄·rî·sāh ṭə·mê·’āh hî lā·ḵem
verses.literal: The rabbit though it chews the cud does not have a divided hoof it is unclean for you
verses.literalPt: E a lebre, porque rumina, mas não tem as unhas fendidas; essa vos será imunda.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַ֠חֲזִיר כִּֽי־ מַפְרִ֨יס פַּרְסָ֜ה ה֗וּא וְשֹׁסַ֥ע שֶׁ֙סַע֙ פַּרְסָ֔ה וְה֖וּא גֵּרָ֣ה לֹֽא־ יִגָּ֑ר טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥă·zîr kî- map̄·rîs par·sāh hū wə·šō·sa‘ še·sa‘ par·sāh wə·hū gê·rāh lō- yig·gār ṭā·mê hū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: And the pig though it has a split hoof completely divided . . . - does not chew the cud it is unclean for you
verses.literalPt: Também o porco, porque tem unhas fendidas, e a fenda das unhas se divide em duas, mas não rumina; este vos será imundo.

verses.original: מִבְּשָׂרָם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּבְנִבְלָתָ֖ם לֹ֣א תִגָּ֑עוּ טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mib·bə·śā·rām lō ṯō·ḵê·lū ū·ḇə·niḇ·lā·ṯām lō ṯig·gā·‘ū ṭə·mê·’îm hêm lā·ḵem
verses.literal: You must not eat their meat or touch their carcasses . . . they are unclean for you
verses.literalPt: Das suas carnes não comereis, nem tocareis nos seus cadáveres; estes vos serão imundos.

verses.original: אֶת־ זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמָּ֑יִם כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֩ סְנַפִּ֨יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֜שֶׂת בַּמַּ֗יִם בַּיַּמִּ֛ים וּבַנְּחָלִ֖ים אֹתָ֥ם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- zeh tō·ḵə·lū mik·kōl ’ă·šer bam·mā·yim kōl ’ă·šer- lōw sə·nap·pîr wə·qaś·qe·śeṯ bam·ma·yim bay·yam·mîm ū·ḇan·nə·ḥā·lîm ’ō·ṯām tō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: Of all the creatures that live in the water whether in the seas or in the streams - you may eat anything with fins and scales . . .
verses.literalPt: De todos os animais que há nas águas, comereis os seguintes: todo o que tem barbatanas e escamas, nas águas, nos mares e nos rios, esses comereis.

verses.original: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵֽין־ ל֜וֹ סְנַפִּ֣יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֗שֶׂת בַּיַּמִּים֙ וּבַנְּחָלִ֔ים מִכֹּל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הַמַּ֔יִם וּמִכֹּ֛ל נֶ֥פֶשׁ הַחַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמָּ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ הֵ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ’ên- lōw sə·nap·pîr wə·qaś·qe·śeṯ bay·yam·mîm ū·ḇan·nə·ḥā·lîm mik·kōl še·reṣ ham·ma·yim ū·mik·kōl ne·p̄eš ha·ḥay·yāh ’ă·šer bam·mā·yim še·qeṣ hêm lā·ḵem
verses.literal: But the following among all the teeming life - and creatures in the water are detestable to you everything in the seas or streams that does not have fins and scales . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas todo o que não tem barbatanas, nem escamas, nos mares e nos rios, todo o réptil das águas, e todo o ser vivente que há nas águas, estes serão para vós abominação.

verses.original: וְשֶׁ֖קֶץ יִהְי֣וּ לָכֶ֑ם מִבְּשָׂרָם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וְאֶת־ נִבְלָתָ֖ם תְּשַׁקֵּֽצוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·še·qeṣ yih·yū lā·ḵem mib·bə·śā·rām lō ṯō·ḵê·lū wə·’eṯ- niḇ·lā·ṯām tə·šaq·qê·ṣū
verses.literal: They shall be an abomination to you you must not eat their meat and you must detest their carcasses
verses.literalPt: Ser-vos-ão, pois, por abominação; da sua carne não comereis, e abominareis o seu cadáver.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין־ ל֛וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְקַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת בַּמָּ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōl ’ă·šer ’ên- lōw sə·nap·pîr wə·qaś·qe·śeṯ bam·mā·yim še·qeṣ hū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Everything in the water that does not have fins and scales shall be detestable . . . to you
verses.literalPt: Todo o que não tem barbatanas ou escamas, nas águas, será para vós abominação.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ תְּשַׁקְּצ֣וּ מִן־ הָע֔וֹף לֹ֥א יֵאָכְל֖וּ שֶׁ֣קֶץ הֵ֑ם אֶת־ הַנֶּ֙שֶׁר֙ וְאֶת־ הַפֶּ֔רֶס וְאֵ֖ת הָעָזְנִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ’êl·leh tə·šaq·qə·ṣū min- hā·‘ō·wp̄ lō yê·’ā·ḵə·lū še·qeṣ hêm ’eṯ- han·ne·šer wə·’eṯ- hap·pe·res wə·’êṯ hā·‘ā·zə·nî·yāh
verses.literal: Additionally you are to detest . . . the following birds and they must not be eaten because they are detestable the eagle the bearded vulture the black vulture
verses.literalPt: Das aves, estas abominareis; não se comerão, serão abominação: a águia, e o quebrantosso, e o xofrango,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַ֨דָּאָ֔ה וְאֶת־ הָאַיָּ֖ה לְמִינָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- had·dā·’āh wə·’eṯ- hā·’ay·yāh lə·mî·nāh
verses.literal: the kite any kind of falcon
verses.literalPt: E o milhano, e o abutre segundo a sua espécie.

verses.original: אֵ֥ת כָּל־ עֹרֵ֖ב לְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ kāl- ‘ō·rêḇ lə·mî·nōw
verses.literal: any kind of raven
verses.literalPt: Todo o corvo segundo a sua espécie,

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ בַּ֣ת הַֽיַּעֲנָ֔ה וְאֶת־ הַתַּחְמָ֖ס וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁ֑חַף וְאֶת־ הַנֵּ֖ץ לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ baṯ hay·ya·‘ă·nāh wə·’eṯ- hat·taḥ·mās wə·’eṯ- haš·šā·ḥap̄ wə·’eṯ- han·nêṣ lə·mî·nê·hū
verses.literal: the ostrich the screech owl the gull any kind of hawk
verses.literalPt: E o avestruz, e o mocho, e a gaivota, e o gavião segundo a sua espécie.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַכּ֥וֹס וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁלָ֖ךְ וְאֶת־ הַיַּנְשֽׁוּף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hak·kō·ws wə·’eṯ- haš·šā·lāḵ wə·’eṯ- hay·yan·šūp̄
verses.literal: the little owl the cormorant the great owl
verses.literalPt: E o bufo, e o corvo marinho, e a coruja,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַתִּנְשֶׁ֥מֶת וְאֶת־ הַקָּאָ֖ת וְאֶת־ הָרָחָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hat·tin·še·meṯ wə·’eṯ- haq·qā·’āṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·rā·ḥām
verses.literal: the white owl the desert owl the osprey
verses.literalPt: E a gralha, e o cisne, e o pelicano,

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ הַחֲסִידָ֔ה הָאֲנָפָ֖ה לְמִינָ֑הּ וְאֶת־ הַדּוּכִיפַ֖ת וְאֶת־ הָעֲטַלֵּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ha·ḥă·sî·ḏāh hā·’ă·nā·p̄āh lə·mî·nāh wə·’eṯ- had·dū·ḵî·p̄aṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ă·ṭal·lêp̄
verses.literal: the stork any kind of heron the hoopoe and the bat
verses.literalPt: E a cegonha, a garça segundo a sua espécie, e a poupa, e o morcego.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל־ אַרְבַּ֑ע שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: kōl še·reṣ hā·‘ō·wp̄ ha·hō·lêḵ ‘al- ’ar·ba‘ še·qeṣ hū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: All flying insects that walk on all fours are detestable . . . to you
verses.literalPt: Todo o inseto que voa, que anda sobre quatro pés, será para vós uma abominação.

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ אֶת־ זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל־ אַרְבַּ֑ע אֲשֶׁר־ לֹא כְרָעַ֙יִם֙ מִמַּ֣עַל לְרַגְלָ֔יו לְנַתֵּ֥ר בָּהֵ֖ן עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’eṯ- zeh tō·ḵə·lū mik·kōl še·reṣ hā·‘ō·wp̄ ha·hō·lêḵ ‘al- ’ar·ba‘ ’ă·šer- lō ḵə·rā·‘a·yim mim·ma·‘al lə·raḡ·lāw lə·nat·têr bā·hên ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: However you may eat the following kinds of flying insects that walk on all fours those having jointed legs above their feet for hopping . . . on the ground
verses.literalPt: Mas isto comereis de todo o inseto que voa, que anda sobre quatro pés: o que tiver pernas sobre os seus pés, para saltar com elas sobre a terra.

verses.original: אֶת־ אֵ֤לֶּה מֵהֶם֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ אֶת־ הָֽאַרְבֶּ֣ה לְמִינ֔וֹ וְאֶת־ הַסָּלְעָ֖ם לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וְאֶת־ הַחַרְגֹּ֣ל לְמִינֵ֔הוּ וְאֶת־ הֶחָגָ֖ב לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ’êl·leh mê·hem tō·ḵê·lū ’eṯ- hā·’ar·beh lə·mî·nōw wə·’eṯ- has·sā·lə·‘ām lə·mî·nê·hū wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥar·gōl lə·mî·nê·hū wə·’eṯ- he·ḥā·ḡāḇ lə·mî·nê·hū
verses.literal: Of these you may eat any kind of locust katydid . . . cricket . . . or grasshopper . . .
verses.literalPt: Deles comereis estes: a locusta segundo a sua espécie, o gafanhoto devorador segundo a sua espécie, o grilo segundo a sua espécie, e o gafanhoto segundo a sua espécie.

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָע֔וֹף אֲשֶׁר־ ל֖וֹ אַרְבַּ֣ע רַגְלָ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl še·reṣ hā·‘ō·wp̄ ’ă·šer- lōw ’ar·ba‘ raḡ·lā·yim še·qeṣ hū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: All other flying insects that have four legs are detestable . . . to you
verses.literalPt: E todos os outros insetos que voam, que têm quatro pés, serão para vós uma abominação.

verses.original: וּלְאֵ֖לֶּה תִּטַּמָּ֑אוּ כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·’êl·leh tiṭ·ṭam·mā·’ū kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·niḇ·lā·ṯām yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: These creatures will make you unclean Whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E por estes sereis imundos: qualquer que tocar os seus cadáveres, imundo será até à tarde.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַנֹּשֵׂ֖א מִנִּבְלָתָ֑ם יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl han·nō·śê min·niḇ·lā·ṯām yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: and whoever picks up one of their carcasses must wash his clothes and he will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: Qualquer que levar os seus cadáveres lavará as suas vestes, e será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: לְֽכָל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֡ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִוא֩ מַפְרֶ֨סֶת פַּרְסָ֜ה וְשֶׁ֣סַע׀ אֵינֶ֣נָּה שֹׁסַ֗עַת וְגֵרָה֙ אֵינֶ֣נָּה מַעֲלָ֔ה טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהֶ֖ם יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵāl hab·bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer hî map̄·re·seṯ par·sāh wə·še·sa‘ ’ê·nen·nāh šō·sa·‘aṯ wə·ḡê·rāh ’ê·nen·nāh ma·‘ă·lāh ṭə·mê·’îm hêm lā·ḵem kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bā·hem yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: Every animal with . . . hooves not completely divided . . . or that does not chew the cud is unclean . . . for you Whoever touches any of them will be unclean
verses.literalPt: Todo o animal que tem unha fendida, mas a fenda não se divide em duas, e todo o que não rumina, vos será por imundo; qualquer que tocar neles será imundo.

verses.original: וְכֹ֣ל׀ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל־ כַּפָּ֗יו בְּכָל־ הַֽחַיָּה֙ הַהֹלֶ֣כֶת עַל־ אַרְבַּ֔ע טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl hō·w·lêḵ ‘al- kap·pāw bə·ḵāl ha·ḥay·yāh ha·hō·le·ḵeṯ ‘al- ’ar·ba‘ ṭə·mê·’îm hêm lā·ḵem kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·niḇ·lā·ṯām yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: All the four-footed . . . . . . animals that walk on their paws . . . are unclean . . . for you whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E todo o animal que anda sobre as suas patas, todo o animal que anda a quatro pés, vos será por imundo; qualquer que tocar nos seus cadáveres será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְהַנֹּשֵׂא֙ אֶת־ נִבְלָתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֣א עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nō·śê ’eṯ- niḇ·lā·ṯām yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ ṭə·mê·’îm hêm·māh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: and anyone who picks up a carcass must wash his clothes and he will be unclean until evening They are unclean for you
verses.literalPt: E o que levar os seus cadáveres lavará as suas vestes, e será imundo até à tarde; eles vos serão por imundos.

verses.original: וְזֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ הַטָּמֵ֔א בַּשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ הַחֹ֥לֶד וְהָעַכְבָּ֖ר וְהַצָּ֥ב לְמִינֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh lā·ḵem haṭ·ṭā·mê baš·še·reṣ haš·šō·rêṣ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ ha·ḥō·leḏ wə·hā·‘aḵ·bār wə·haṣ·ṣāḇ lə·mî·nê·hū
verses.literal: The following creatures that move along the ground are unclean for you the mole the mouse any kind of great lizard
verses.literalPt: Estes também vos serão por imundos entre os répteis que se arrastam sobre a terra; a doninha, e o rato, e a tartaruga segundo a sua espécie,

verses.original: וְהָאֲנָקָ֥ה וְהַכֹּ֖חַ וְהַלְּטָאָ֑ה וְהַחֹ֖מֶט וְהַתִּנְשָֽׁמֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ă·nā·qāh wə·hak·kō·aḥ wə·hal·lə·ṭā·’āh wə·ha·ḥō·meṭ wə·hat·tin·šā·meṯ
verses.literal: the gecko the monitor lizard the common lizard the skink and the chameleon
verses.literalPt: E o ouriço cacheiro, e o lagarto, e a lagartixa, e a lesma e a toupeira.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה הַטְּמֵאִ֥ים לָכֶ֖ם בְּכָל־ הַשָּׁ֑רֶץ כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֧עַ בָּהֶ֛ם בְּמֹתָ֖ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh haṭ·ṭə·mê·’îm lā·ḵem bə·ḵāl haš·šā·reṣ kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bā·hem bə·mō·ṯām yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: These animals are unclean for you among all the crawling creatures Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: Estes vos serão por imundos dentre todos os répteis; qualquer que os tocar, estando eles mortos, será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִפֹּל־ עָלָיו֩ מֵהֶ֨ם׀ בְּמֹתָ֜ם יִטְמָ֗א מִכָּל־ כְּלִי־ עֵץ֙ א֣וֹ בֶ֤גֶד אוֹ־ עוֹר֙ א֣וֹ שָׂ֔ק כָּל־ כְּלִ֕י אֲשֶׁר־ יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה מְלָאכָ֖ה בָּהֶ֑ם בַּמַּ֧יִם יוּבָ֛א וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעֶ֖רֶב וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yip·pōl- ‘ā·lāw mê·hem bə·mō·ṯām yiṭ·mā mik·kāl kə·lî- ‘êṣ ’ōw ḇe·ḡeḏ ’ōw- ‘ō·wr ’ōw śāq kāl- kə·lî ’ă·šer- yê·‘ā·śeh mə·lā·ḵāh bā·hem bam·ma·yim yū·ḇā wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘e·reḇ wə·ṭā·hêr
verses.literal: When one of them dies and falls on something that article becomes unclean any article of wood . . . clothing . . . leather . . . sackcloth or any implement used for work must be rinsed with water . . . and will remain unclean until evening then it will be clean
verses.literalPt: E tudo aquilo sobre o que cair alguma coisa deles estando eles mortos será imundo; seja vaso de madeira, ou veste, ou pele, ou saco, qualquer instrumento, com que se faz alguma obra, será posto na água, e será imundo até à tarde; depois será limpo.

verses.original: וְכָל־ כְּלִי־ חֶ֔רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר־ יִפֹּ֥ל מֵהֶ֖ם אֶל־ תּוֹכ֑וֹ כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹכ֛וֹ יִטְמָ֖א וְאֹת֥וֹ תִשְׁבֹּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl kə·lî- ḥe·reś ’ă·šer- yip·pōl mê·hem ’el- tō·w·ḵōw kōl ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·w·ḵōw yiṭ·mā wə·’ō·ṯōw ṯiš·bō·rū
verses.literal: If any of them falls into . . . a clay pot everything in it will be unclean you must break the pot
verses.literalPt: E todo o vaso de barro, em que cair alguma coisa deles, tudo o que houver nele será imundo, e o vaso quebrareis.

verses.original: מִכָּל־ הָאֹ֜כֶל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵאָכֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָב֥וֹא עָלָ֛יו מַ֖יִם יִטְמָ֑א וְכָל־ מַשְׁקֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשָּׁתֶ֔ה בְּכָל־ כְּלִ֖י יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: mik·kāl hā·’ō·ḵel ’ă·šer yê·’ā·ḵêl ’ă·šer yā·ḇō·w ‘ā·lāw ma·yim yiṭ·mā wə·ḵāl maš·qeh ’ă·šer yiš·šā·ṯeh bə·ḵāl kə·lî yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: Any food coming into contact with water from that pot will be unclean and any drink . . . in such a container will be unclean
verses.literalPt: Todo o alimento que se come, sobre o qual cair água de tais vasos, será imundo; e toda a bebida que se bebe, depositada nesses vasos, será imunda.

verses.original: וְ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר־ יִפֹּ֨ל מִנִּבְלָתָ֥ם׀ עָלָיו֮ יִטְמָא֒ תַּנּ֧וּר וְכִירַ֛יִם יֻתָּ֖ץ טְמֵאִ֣ים הֵ֑ם וּטְמֵאִ֖ים יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yip·pōl min·niḇ·lā·ṯām ‘ā·lāw yiṭ·mā tan·nūr wə·ḵî·ra·yim yut·tāṣ ṭə·mê·’îm hêm ū·ṭə·mê·’îm yih·yū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Anything upon which one of their carcasses falls will be unclean If it is an oven or cooking pot it must be smashed it is unclean and will remain unclean for you
verses.literalPt: E aquilo sobre o que cair alguma parte de seu corpo morto, será imundo; o forno e o vaso de barro serão quebrados; imundos são: portanto vos serão por imundos.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ מַעְיָ֥ן וּב֛וֹר מִקְוֵה־ מַ֖יִם יִהְיֶ֣ה טָה֑וֹר וְנֹגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖ם יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ma‘·yān ū·ḇō·wr miq·wêh- ma·yim yih·yeh ṭā·hō·wr wə·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·niḇ·lā·ṯām yiṭ·mā
verses.literal: Nevertheless a spring or cistern containing water will remain clean but one who touches a carcass in it will be unclean
verses.literalPt: Porém a fonte ou cisterna, em que se recolhem águas, será limpa, mas quem tocar no seu cadáver será imundo.

verses.original: וְכִ֤י יִפֹּל֙ מִנִּבְלָתָ֔ם עַל־ כָּל־ זֶ֥רַע זֵר֖וּעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִזָּרֵ֑עַ טָה֖וֹר הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî yip·pōl min·niḇ·lā·ṯām ‘al- kāl- ze·ra‘ zê·rū·a‘ ’ă·šer yiz·zā·rê·a‘ ṭā·hō·wr hū
verses.literal: If a carcass falls on any seed for sowing - the seed is clean
verses.literalPt: E, se dos seus cadáveres cair alguma coisa sobre alguma semente que se vai semear, será limpa;

verses.original: וְכִ֤י יֻתַּן־ מַ֙יִם֙ עַל־ זֶ֔רַע וְנָפַ֥ל מִנִּבְלָתָ֖ם עָלָ֑יו טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî yut·tan- ma·yim ‘al- ze·ra‘ wə·nā·p̄al min·niḇ·lā·ṯām ‘ā·lāw ṭā·mê hū lā·ḵem
verses.literal: but if water has been put on the seed and a carcass falls on it it is unclean for you
verses.literalPt: Mas se for deitada água sobre a semente, e se dos seus cadáveres cair alguma coisa sobre ela, vos será por imunda.

verses.original: וְכִ֤י יָמוּת֙ מִן־ הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ הִ֥יא לָכֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָ֑ה הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּנִבְלָתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî yā·mūṯ min- hab·bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer- hî lā·ḵem lə·’āḵ·lāh han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·niḇ·lā·ṯāh yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: If an animal that . . . you may eat dies anyone who touches the carcass will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E se morrer algum dos animais, que vos servem de mantimento, quem tocar no seu cadáver será imundo até à tarde;

verses.original: וְהָֽאֹכֵל֙ מִנִּבְלָתָ֔הּ יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֣א עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב וְהַנֹּשֵׂא֙ אֶת־ נִבְלָתָ֔הּ יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ō·ḵêl min·niḇ·lā·ṯāh yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ wə·han·nō·śê ’eṯ- niḇ·lā·ṯāh yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Whoever eats from the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening and anyone who picks up the carcass must wash his clothes and will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E quem comer do seu cadáver lavará as suas vestes, e será imundo até à tarde; e quem levar o seu corpo morto lavará as suas vestes, e será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl haš·še·reṣ haš·šō·rêṣ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ še·qeṣ hū lō yê·’ā·ḵêl
verses.literal: Every creature that moves along the ground is detestable it must not be eaten
verses.literalPt: Também todo o réptil, que se arrasta sobre a terra, será abominação; não se comerá.

verses.original: כֹּל֩ הוֹלֵ֨ךְ עַל־ גָּח֜וֹן וְכֹ֣ל׀ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל־ אַרְבַּ֗ע עַ֚ד כָּל־ מַרְבֵּ֣ה רַגְלַ֔יִם לְכָל־ הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ לֹ֥א תֹאכְל֖וּם כִּי־ שֶׁ֥קֶץ הֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōl hō·w·lêḵ ‘al- gå̄·ḥōn wə·ḵōl hō·w·lêḵ ‘al- ’ar·ba‘ ‘aḏ kāl- mar·bêh raḡ·la·yim lə·ḵāl haš·še·reṣ haš·šō·rêṣ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ lō ṯō·ḵə·lūm kî- še·qeṣ hêm
verses.literal: Do not eat any creature that moves along the ground whether it crawls on its belly or walks on four or . . . more feet . . . for such creatures are detestable
verses.literalPt: Tudo o que anda sobre o ventre, e tudo o que anda sobre quatro pés, ou que tem muitos pés, entre todo o réptil que se arrasta sobre a terra, não comereis, porquanto são uma abominação.

verses.original: אַל־ תְּשַׁקְּצוּ֙ אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכָל־ הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֑ץ וְלֹ֤א תִֽטַּמְּאוּ֙ בָּהֶ֔ם וְנִטְמֵתֶ֖ם בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·šaq·qə·ṣū ’eṯ- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem bə·ḵāl haš·še·reṣ haš·šō·rêṣ wə·lō ṯiṭ·ṭam·mə·’ū bā·hem wə·niṭ·mê·ṯem bām
verses.literal: Do not defile yourselves by any crawling creature . . . do not become unclean or defiled by them
verses.literalPt: Não vos façais abomináveis, por nenhum réptil que se arrasta, nem neles vos contamineis, para não serdes imundos por eles;

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֮ אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֒ וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם֙ וִהְיִיתֶ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אָ֑נִי וְלֹ֤א תְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכָל־ הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הָרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·hiṯ·qad·diš·tem wih·yî·ṯem qə·ḏō·šîm kî qā·ḏō·wōš ’ā·nî wə·lō ṯə·ṭam·mə·’ū ’eṯ- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem bə·ḵāl haš·še·reṣ hā·rō·mêś ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For I am the LORD your God consecrate yourselves, therefore and be holy because I am holy You must not defile yourselves by any creature that crawls along the ground
verses.literalPt: Porque eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus; portanto vós vos santificareis, e sereis santos, porque eu sou santo; e não vos contaminareis com nenhum réptil que se arrasta sobre a terra;

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה הַֽמַּעֲלֶ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְיֹ֥ת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים וִהְיִיתֶ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ham·ma·‘ă·leh ’eṯ·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lih·yōṯ lā·ḵem lê·lō·hîm wih·yî·ṯem qə·ḏō·šîm kî qā·ḏō·wōš ’ā·nî
verses.literal: For I am the LORD who brought you up out of the land of Egypt so that I would be your God therefore be holy because I am holy
verses.literalPt: Porque eu sou o SENHOR, que vos fiz subir da terra do Egito, para que eu seja vosso Deus, e para que sejais santos; porque eu sou santo.

verses.original: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֤ת הַבְּהֵמָה֙ וְהָע֔וֹף וְכֹל֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַֽחַיָּ֔ה הָרֹמֶ֖שֶׂת בַּמָּ֑יִם וּלְכָל־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ הַשֹּׁרֶ֥צֶת עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tō·w·raṯ hab·bə·hê·māh wə·hā·‘ō·wp̄ wə·ḵōl ne·p̄eš ha·ḥay·yāh hā·rō·me·śeṯ bam·mā·yim ū·lə·ḵāl- ne·p̄eš haš·šō·re·ṣeṯ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: This is the law regarding animals birds all living creatures that move in the water and all creatures that crawl along the ground
verses.literalPt: Esta é a lei dos animais, e das aves, e de toda criatura vivente que se move nas águas, e de toda criatura que se arrasta sobre a terra;

verses.original: לְהַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַטָּמֵ֖א וּבֵ֣ין הַטָּהֹ֑ר וּבֵ֤ין הַֽחַיָּה֙ הַֽנֶּאֱכֶ֔לֶת וּבֵין֙ הַֽחַיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א תֵאָכֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·haḇ·dîl bên haṭ·ṭā·mê ū·ḇên haṭ·ṭā·hōr ū·ḇên ha·ḥay·yāh han·ne·’ĕ·ḵe·leṯ ū·ḇên ha·ḥay·yāh ’ă·šer lō ṯê·’ā·ḵêl
verses.literal: You must distinguish between the unclean and the clean . . . between animals that may be eaten . . . and those that may not
verses.literalPt: Para fazer diferença entre o imundo e o limpo; e entre animais que se podem comer e os animais que não se podem comer.
